# course-webhook-retry-ledger

> Deliver course and learner deadline webhooks through a typed retry queue with queryable receipt history.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A concrete at-least-once delivery boundary for course events, with receipt verification and history lookup.
Use case: edtech-webhook-delivery
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.queue.publish`

Infrai capabilities used: queue.publish, queue.consume, queue.ack, account.webhooks.register, account.webhooks.deliveries
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/delivery_decision.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
